# Channels (7)

The `Channel` union (`src/spine/db.ts`). Every captured event lands on exactly one.

| channel | hooks assigned here | carries the tool join |
|---|---|---|
| `hook_callback` | `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`, `MessageDisplay`, `PermissionRequest`, `PostToolBatch`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `PreCompact`, `PermissionDenied`, `ConfigChange`, `WorktreeCreate`, `WorktreeRemove`, `Elicitation`, `ElicitationResult`, `FileChanged`, `CwdChanged`, `StopFailure`, `TeammateIdle`, `Notification`, `UserPromptExpansion` | - |
| `message_stream` | - | yes |
| `transcript` | - | - |
| `gate` | - | yes |
| `run_meta` | - | - |
| `otel` | - | yes |
| `settings_hook` | `PostCompact`, `ConfigChange`, `WorktreeCreate`, `WorktreeRemove`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `InstructionsLoaded`, `TaskCreated`, `TaskCompleted`, `Setup`, `Elicitation`, `ElicitationResult`, `FileChanged`, `CwdChanged`, `StopFailure`, `TeammateIdle`, `Notification`, `UserPromptExpansion` | - |

> A tool is `fired_verified` only with all three join channels on one `tool_use_id`
> (`message_stream` tool_use + `gate` PreToolUse.gate + `otel` tool_result), plus a `gate`
> `neo.decision` for the human-seat group. A hook fires on its assigned channel(s) above.
